reason: Both Core and Frontend directly use Laravel Prompts when installed independently, so declaring laravel/prompts at ^0.2|^0.3 in each package fixes a real shadow-dependency packaging defect rather than adding an arbitrary requirement. The migrations drift is pre-existing on origin/main, including the 2026_08_14_000001_add_provider_recovery_to_capell_extensions.php migration, and is not caused by this PR.
